name: Viking longship
notes: Origin at the waterline centre, bow +Z, port +X. Joints oars 0...1 (stroke cycle; 32 oars mimic it, alternating oars carry an offset), sail 0...1 (furled bundle to set sail), sway -1...1 (roll 4 degrees). Brazier light on the hull.
parts: clinker hull of ten overlapping oak strakes per side over a keel
ribs, cross beams, keelson, mast partner and lined interior
carved dragon prow swept from a tapered neck with bronze collars, jaw, teeth, horns
12 round shields per side with iron bosses and rims on a shield rail
16 oars per side on iron thole pins
mast with fore and back stays
striped square sail on a yard, furled bundle option
iron fire brazier with coals and flame
style: Gokstad-type Viking longship, weathered oak and tarred planks, red and cream striped sail, painted round shields, dawn-river realism.
summary: 22 m clinker-built oak longship: carved dragon prow, round shields, 32 oars, striped square sail, steering oar and fire brazier.
